title: Warm and cool colours and the moods they make
examples: Why do blue rooms feel calm?

explain.say: Close your eyes and picture a campfire. Now picture a deep, cold lake. Did the colours change in your head? Artists sort colours into two families: warm and cool. Look at the board and help me sort them.

draw.text: Warm and cool colours and the moods they make

explain.say: Look at the warm group: red, orange and yellow, the colours of fire, the sun and a sunset over the desert in Egypt. Warm colours feel lively, cosy and full of energy. What warm-coloured food can you think of?
Now the cool group: blue, green and violet, the colours of the sea, grass and ice. Cool colours feel calm, fresh and quiet. Which colour group would you paint a bedroom for a sleepy baby?

Look at this colour meter. As we move from cool blue to fiery red, the feeling rises from calm to bold and strong. Artists choose colours to tell you how to feel. But meanings change around the world: in China and India, red means luck and joy at weddings. Where does the needle point for yellow?

explain.say: Wonderful sorting! Wow fact: warm colours seem to jump towards you and cool colours seem to sink back, so painters use blue-grey for far mountains and warm reds up front. Challenge: draw a picture twice, once all warm and once all cool, and see how the mood changes.

faq.a: Warm colours are red, orange and yellow, the colours of fire and sunshine. They often feel energetic, cosy or exciting.
asks: Why are red and orange called warm?

faq.a: Cool colours are blue, green and violet, the colours of water, plants and ice. They often feel calm, peaceful and fresh.
asks: Why is blue a cool colour?

faq.a: Green is usually counted as cool, but a yellow-green leans warm and a blue-green leans cool. Every colour can be a warmer or cooler version of itself.
asks: Can a colour be both warm and cool?

faq.q: What does the colour red mean?
faq.a: It depends on where you are. Red can mean danger or stop, love, or energy. In China red stands for luck and happiness, and in India many brides wear red.
asks: Why do brides wear red in India?
Do colours mean the same everywhere?

faq.q: How do artists use warm and cool colours?
faq.a: They use warm colours to grab attention or show heat and excitement, and cool colours for calm, cold or distance. Warm colours seem to come forward and cool ones to move back.

facts: Red, orange and yellow are called warm colours; blue, green and violet are called cool colours.
In Chinese culture red is traditionally the colour of good luck and celebration.

quiz.say: Which of these is a cool colour?
quiz.why: Blue is the colour of water and ice, a cool colour.

wrong.2: Red is warm, like heat and flames.

quiz.say: You want a poster that feels exciting and full of energy. Which colours should you use most?
quiz.why: Warm colours like red, orange and yellow feel lively and grab attention.

wrong.1: Cool colours feel calm and quiet.
